newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Gucci says revenues soar 69 percent.
newsitem.headline: Gucci says revenues soar 69 percent.

text.p: Luxury goods maker Gucci Group said Thursday its revenues jumped 69 percent in the third quarter, boosted by strong sales of leather goods and shoes.
Wall Street was not impressed with the big gain in revenues, however, as Gucci's stock dropped $3.50 to $74 on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company reported sales of $230.2 million, up from $136.1 million in the third quarter of 1995.

During the third quarter, sales through directly operated stores increased 64.9 percent, while wholesale sales via franchise, duty free, and speciality stores, were up 110.8 percent from last year, Gucci said.
Leather goods and shoes were the strongest product categories, with sales rising 94.7 percent and 68.9 percent, respectively, it said.
Gucci said year-to-date, its total revenues were up 81.2 percent to $620.2 million.
